selection: First two validation queries per class in saved order, no outcome selection.
purpose: Check complete 2000-step full versus exact-boundary-local CF2 optimization before scaling the joint-objective baseline. Not a quality comparison powered for inference.
equivalence_requirements: Same original-n initialization variance, same per-query RNG seed, same candidate/parameter order, same loss and optimizer. Preserve original full logit for class sign. Recompute physical original-graph metrics for every returned hard support.
limits: Exact-arithmetic objective and gradient locality does not guarantee identical floating-point optimizer trajectories or top-B rankings. Record soft-mask differences, support identity, decisions and loss diagnostics rather than assuming equivalence. Timings are single paired runs in alternating order, not repeated controlled speed measurements.
manuscript: No empirical LaTeX updates. Preserve both outcomes even if masks or supports disagree.
